subtitle.en: Standardizing our shaders on a fixed subset of HLSL, then generating the target shading language by transforming a syntax tree.
subtitle.zh: 把着色器统一到 HLSL 的一个固定子集上，再通过变换语法树来生成目标平台所用的着色语言。

translator.note: 本篇是 Ignacio Castaño 介绍如何用 HLSLParser 把着色器代码标准化到 HLSL 的子集、再转换到各个目标平台；技术标识符（D3D11、HLSL、GLSL、PSSL 等）一律保留英文。原文的三处无序列表按 schema 的 list 块保留，条目文本与原文一一对应（不含 markdown 的项目符号）。

blocks.en: We just finished porting The Witness to D3D11. It took a little longer than I was hoping and one of the unexpected difficulties was getting our D3D9 HLSL shaders to work in D3D11.
blocks.zh: 我们刚刚把《The Witness》移植到 D3D11 上。花的时间比我期望的要长一些，而其中一个意料之外的难点，是让我们那些 D3D9 时代的 HLSL 着色器在 D3D11 里正常工作。

blocks.en: The D3D shader compiler provides a backward compatibility flag (D3DCOMPILE_ENABLE_BACKWARDS_COMPATIBILITY) that I was hoping would allow us to use our shaders 'as is'. Unfortunately, it seems the backward compatibility mode has not received much love and things were not that simple. I run into several compiler internal errors, and even after finding workarounds most of our shaders did not actually compile, but would have required significant modifications, the resulting vertex and pixel shaders would often not link at runtime, and the use of register annotations on samplers only allowed us to control the layout of the samplers, but not of the associated textures.
blocks.zh: D3D 的着色器编译器提供了一个向后兼容的开关（D3DCOMPILE_ENABLE_BACKWARDS_COMPATIBILITY），我本来指望它能让我们「原样」使用现有的着色器。可惜，向后兼容模式似乎并没人疼没人爱，事情远没那么简单。我撞上了好几个编译器内部错误；即便找到了绕开的办法，我们的大多数着色器实际上还是编不过，需要做大量修改；生成的顶点和像素着色器在运行时也常常链接不上；而在采样器上使用寄存器标注，只让我们控制得了采样器的布局，控制不了与之关联的纹理。

blocks.en: For other targets (Cg & PSSL) we had been able to get away with some preprocessor macros and simple text transformations, but it seemed that was not going to be an option in this case. Not only that, having to write and adapt our shader code for the idiosyncrasies of each compiler was starting to become a challenge.
blocks.zh: 对其他目标平台（Cg 和 PSSL），我们过去靠几个预处理器宏加一些简单的文本变换就能蒙混过去，但这一次看来行不通了。不仅如此，为了迁就每个编译器的怪癖而反复编写、改写着色器代码，也开始变成一件难事。

blocks.en: Instead, I thought it would be much cleaner and much more powerful to standardize on a fixed subset of HLSL and transform it to the shading language of the target by building a syntax tree, applying syntactic transformations, and generating shader code by traversing the resulting syntax tree.
blocks.zh: 于是我想到，更干净、也更强大的做法是：把 HLSL 的一个固定子集定为标准，然后通过建立语法树、施加语法层面的变换、再遍历这棵语法树来生成着色器代码，从而把代码转换到目标平台所用的着色语言。

blocks.en: This is essentially what we already do in the OpenGL backend to transform GLSL into HLSL. For that we use [HLSL2GLSL](https://github.com/aras-p/hlsl2glslfork) and [GLSLOptimizer](https://github.com/aras-p/glsl-optimizer). I considered using these same projects, either modifying HLSL2GLSL to output HLSL1x code instead of GLSL, or modifying GLSLOptimizer to accept and produce HLSL code. I avoided the former, because HLSL2GLSL's code was a big mess and it was not very attractive to work with it. The latter was more interesting, and I believe it's the approach taken by the UE4 engine. However, while much cleaner, GLSLOptimizer is still a fairly large project and I did not care too much about the optimization aspects that it offered.
blocks.zh: 这基本上就是我们在 OpenGL 后端里把 GLSL 转成 HLSL 时已经在做的事。为此我们用的是 [HLSL2GLSL](https://github.com/aras-p/hlsl2glslfork) 和 [GLSLOptimizer](https://github.com/aras-p/glsl-optimizer)。我考虑过直接复用这两个项目：要么改 HLSL2GLSL，让它输出 HLSL1x 代码而不是 GLSL；要么改 GLSLOptimizer，让它能接受并产出 HLSL 代码。我避开了前者，因为 HLSL2GLSL 的代码一团乱，跟它打交道毫无吸引力。后者更有意思，我相信 UE4 引擎走的就是这条路。不过，GLSLOptimizer 虽然干净得多，仍然是个相当大的项目，而它提供的那些优化功能我并不太在意。

blocks.en: Another option that I had just come across is Max McGuire's [HLSLParser](https://github.com/unknownworlds/hlslparser). HLSLParser was a lot smaller and cleaner than either of those code bases. It was pretty much the code I would have written if I were to do this from scratch, so it seemed like the best possible starting point.
blocks.zh: 我刚刚还看到另一个选择：Max McGuire 的 [HLSLParser](https://github.com/unknownworlds/hlslparser)。它比上面那两个代码库都小得多、也干净得多。它差不多就是我从零开始做这件事会写出来的代码，所以看起来是最好的起点。

blocks.en: One of the main annoyances when working in the OpenGL backend is that GLSL errors are extremely hard to track down. They can be reported by either HLSL2GLSL, GLSLOptimizer, or the driver's GLSL compiler. Each of the inputs to these compilers has different file and line information and none of them matches the original source code. Whenever an error occurs we have to dump the intermediate code and figure out from there what's going on. It's usually a waste of time and if D3D11 is to become our primary backend I did not want to have to deal with this issue.
blocks.zh: 在 OpenGL 后端里干活时，最让人恼火的事情之一，是 GLSL 的报错极难追查。报错可能来自 HLSL2GLSL，可能来自 GLSLOptimizer，也可能来自驱动里的 GLSL 编译器。这些编译器的每一层输入都有各自不同的文件与行号信息，而且没有一个跟原始源代码对得上。一旦出错，我们就得把中间代码 dump 出来，再从那里推断问题出在哪。这通常是纯粹浪费时间；而如果 D3D11 要成为我们的主后端，我可不想再应付这个麻烦。

blocks.en: I was happy to see that HLSLParser handled this correctly associating file and line info to the tree nodes and producing correct #file preprocessor statements in the generated output.
blocks.zh: 让我高兴的是，HLSLParser 把这件事处理对了：它把文件与行号信息关联到语法树节点上，并在生成的输出里产出正确的 #file 预处理语句。

blocks.en: In order to parse our shaders with HLSLParser we had to extend it in several ways, here's a partial list of the features I added:
blocks.zh: 为了能用 HLSLParser 解析我们的着色器，我们不得不在好几个方向上扩展它。以下是我添加的功能的部分清单：

items.en: Support for 3D, 2DMS and shadow samplers, and most of the associated intrinsics.
items.zh: 支持 3D、2DMS 和阴影采样器，以及大部分与之相关的内建函数。

items.en: Added support for many missing intrinsics.
items.zh: 补上了许多缺失的内建函数。

items.en: out argument modifier.
items.zh: out 参数修饰符。

items.en: Default argument values.
items.zh: 参数默认值。

items.en: Block statements.
items.zh: 语句块。

items.en: Attribute annotations.
items.zh: 属性标注。

items.en: Static, inline, uniform and other type modifiers.
items.zh: static、inline、uniform 以及其他类型修饰符。

items.en: Bitwise operators.
items.zh: 位运算符。

items.en: Hex literals.
items.zh: 十六进制字面量。

items.en: Full declaration syntax, including multiple declarations in the statement.
items.zh: 完整的声明语法，包括在同一条语句里声明多个变量。

items.en: Add support for full declarations in buffer fields.
items.zh: 让 buffer 字段也支持完整声明。

items.en: Effect syntax (techniques, passes, sampler states, state assignments).
items.zh: Effect 语法（technique、pass、采样器状态、状态赋值）。

blocks.en: I'm very thankful for the work Max McGuire did on HLSLParser and the least I can do is to release these our improvements to the public as well. You can find our fork of the project in our github repository:
blocks.zh: 我非常感谢 Max McGuire 在 HLSLParser 上所做的工作，而我最起码能做的，就是把这些改进也公开出去。我们项目的 fork 可以在我们的 github 仓库里找到：

blocks.en: Once we have the syntax tree in memory we can do many cool code transformations. In particular, we do:
blocks.zh: 只要语法树进了内存，我们就能做许多很酷的代码变换。具体来说，我们会做这些事：

items.en: Dead code elimination.
items.zh: 死代码消除。

items.en: Determine used parameters and resources.
items.zh: 判定哪些参数和资源被用到了。

items.en: Assign registers/offsets explicitly to control layout of parameters and resources.
items.zh: 显式分配寄存器与偏移，以控制参数和资源的布局。

items.en: Sort resource registers and group parameters in buffers based on frequency of change.
items.zh: 按变化频率对资源寄存器排序，并把参数分组放进 buffer。

items.en: Rename semantics.
items.zh: 重命名语义（semantics）。

items.en: Reorder pixel shader arguments so that vertex shader outputs match pixel shader inputs and avoid linkage errors.
items.zh: 重排像素着色器的参数，让顶点着色器的输出与像素着色器的输入对得上，从而避免链接错误。

blocks.en: The shaders that result from these transformations are minimal, that is, they only contain the definitions and declarations that are necessary for a specific entry point. We have complete control of the layout of resources and parameters and extract all the necessary information about the shader from the tree instead of relying on the platform-specific reflection APIs. The shader transformation is very fast and the resulting shaders compile faster than the original ones. Our new D3D11 shader processor and compiler is about 4 times faster than its D3D9 counterpart.
blocks.zh: 经过这些变换得到的着色器是最精简的：它们只包含某个特定入口点所需的定义和声明。资源和参数的布局完全由我们掌控，关于着色器的一切必要信息都从语法树里取，而不再依赖平台特有的反射 API。着色器变换非常快，得到的着色器编译起来也比原来的更快。我们新的 D3D11 着色器处理器与编译器，比对应的 D3D9 版本大约快 4 倍。

blocks.en: While it currently accepts all of our shaders, HLSLParser still has some limitations. Here are a few that come to mind:
blocks.zh: 虽然 HLSLParser 目前能接受我们所有的着色器，它仍然有一些局限。这里列出我马上能想到的几条：

items.en: No type inference for sampler types. It assumes sampler == sampler2D.
items.zh: 采样器类型没有类型推断。它假定 sampler 就是 sampler2D。

items.en: No support for {} initializers. Instead of float2 p = {0, 0} you have to write float2 p = float2(0, 0). This particular case is not complicated, but it does get more hairy when initializing structures. For now, I've simply modified our shaders to avoid this.
items.zh: 不支持 {} 形式的初始化。你没法写 `float2 p = {0, 0}`，只能写成 `float2 p = float2(0, 0)`。这一具体情形并不复杂，但初始化结构体时就麻烦多了。目前我干脆改了自己的着色器，绕开这种写法。

items.en: No support for rectangular matrices. We did not support them in the GLSL translators either, so we avoided their use in our shaders. It would be nice to add this eventually.
items.zh: 不支持矩形矩阵。我们在 GLSL 那两个转换器里也没支持过，所以着色器里一直避开这种用法。以后能补上就好了。

items.en: No support for do, while or switch statements. These should be easy to add, but we just didn't need them!
items.zh: 不支持 do、while 或 switch 语句。这些应该很容易加上，只是我们根本用不到！

items.en: No proper error recovery. We stop reporting errors after first one. This would be nice, but is not critical.
items.zh: 没有正经的错误恢复机制。报出第一个错误之后我们就停止报错了。能做好当然好，但并不关键。

items.en: Semantic analysis is incomplete. The parser does some, but not a complete semantic check. The generated shader is not guaranteed to be correct in the absence of errors, but since we have proper file/line annotations, this usually doesn't really matter.
items.zh: 语义分析并不完整。解析器只做了一部分语义检查，而不是完整的检查。因此，没有报错并不保证生成的着色器一定正确；不过既然我们有正确的文件与行号标注，这一点通常也就无所谓了。

blocks.en: Looking forward, I expect we will add code generators to target other platforms. It should be really easy to bring the existing GLSLGenerator up to date, or add new generators for PSSL and Metal.
blocks.zh: 往后看，我预计我们会加上面向其他平台的代码生成器。把现有的 GLSLGenerator 更新到位，或者为 PSSL 和 Metal 添加新的生成器，应该都非常容易。

blocks.en: I'm not particularly fond of our shader code. On one side, we abuse the preprocessor to generate shader variations and the result is often a mess that is hard to read and modify. On the other, our code is often highly repetitive, but there doesn't seem to be a clean way to share it across different materials or structure it in a way that's more compact. I'm particularly interested in experimenting with higher level code transformations, or coming up with new constructs to facilitate writing and sharing shader code.
blocks.zh: 我不太喜欢我们的着色器代码。一方面，我们滥用预处理器来生成着色器的各种变体，结果往往是一团乱，既难读也难改。另一方面，我们的代码常常高度重复，却似乎没有一种干净的办法把它在不同材质之间共享，或者组织得更紧凑一些。我特别想试试更高层的代码变换，或者发明一些新的构造，让着色器代码写起来、共享起来更省事。
